families.rationale: The title states only broad end-to-end investment banking workflows and does not identify a specific admitted division or terminal task without pooling or inference.
The inventory card does not name whether coverage is advisory, capital-markets origination, research, or another role, nor does it state partial-coverage limits.
No division is promoted from the generic terms banker, banking, or workflows, so lexical false friends remain unpainted.
Removing the public title and URL leaves no evidence for any mapping claim; no residual owner intuition is used to create a row.
An outsider can reproduce the empty mapping by comparing the broad inventory title with the more specific admitted division labels and applying the stated rejection discipline.

notes: No mapping is emitted because the card supplies no division-specific or task-specific scope sufficient to choose among admitted investment-banking-related keys.
